description: This file contains a Kotlin class implementing an SQLiteOpenHelper for managing a notes database in an Android application. It handles database creation, schema definition, upgrading, and indexing.

classes.name: NotesDatabaseHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing the notes SQLite database, including schema creation and upgrade logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and an index on the 'updated_at' column.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Drops the existing notes table and recreates it, used for schema migrations.
